baselineDisplay.title: Cao Xueqin Biography
baselineDisplay.text: The book tells the life story of the novelist Cao Xueqin, author of The Dream of the Red Mansions. Cao was born to a rich family but suffered great poverty for most of his life. He drew on his life experiences to write this famous novel, which was published after his death.
